people.name: Desmond Okafor
people.bio: Twenty years in hotel LP. Hired you, expects you to write it down, and never raises his voice. Your mentor, if you let him be.

people.name: Marguerite Ellery
people.bio: Runs the Harbourfront like a ship. Cares about guests, reviews and the owners' numbers, in that order on a good day.

people.name: Felix Amadi
people.bio: Keeps the hotel running from midnight to seven. Calm on the radio, tired by four.

people.name: Colm Brady
people.bio: Fifteen years on the floor, sure of his instincts, short on paperwork. Wanted your job for his nephew.

people.name: Ines Dalca
people.bio: Your partner on nights. Ex-paramedic, first-aid trainer, dry sense of humour.

people.name: Priyanka Venn
people.bio: Fair process before everything. Will back you if your file is clean and bury you if it is not.

people.name: Tomasz Rydell
people.bio: Knows every valve and panel in the building and resents every work order that is not his idea.

people.name: Lucia Ferrante
people.bio: Protective of her team of ninety. Will not forgive anyone who accuses one of them without evidence.

people.name: Gideon Marsh
people.bio: Measured on guest satisfaction scores and arrival times. Sees LP as the department of no.

people.name: Rafael Quintero
people.bio: Banquets, bars and the kitchen. Generous with comps, allergic to stock counts.

people.name: Imogen Pryce
people.bio: Balances the day's takings at 3 a.m. and notices everything.

people.name: Callum Fenwick
people.bio: Runs the contract guards on the doors and the dock. Good people, thin staffing.

people.name: Odile Marchetti
people.bio: Reads every file twice. Rewards clean evidence and punishes admissions of liability.

people.name: Ruth Calloway
people.role: Detective Sergeant, Port Avener Police Department
people.bio: Your liaison at the PAPD. Wants footage exported properly and statements nobody has coached.

people.name: Bernard Okoye
people.role: Fire Marshal, Port Avener Fire & Rescue
people.bio: Inspects the Harbourfront twice a year and remembers every blocked exit he has ever seen.

people.name: Anders Whitlock
people.bio: In town for a two-day sales conference. Tired, a few drinks in, and certain someone has been in his room.

people.name: Marisol Duarte
people.bio: Eleven years at the Harbourfront. Does the turndowns on floors 12 to 15 and restocks the floor closets before she goes home.

people.name: Nadia Kerr
people.bio: Closes the Lobby Bar most nights and hands everything she finds to the front desk.

people.name: Tariq Bello
people.bio: Six months in the job. Wants to help everyone who walks up to the desk.

people.name: Leon Haskett
people.bio: Says he is locked out of 1418 and that his wallet is in the room.

people.name: Simone Achterberg
people.bio: Checked in alone two nights ago. Asked at check-in that her room number not be given out.

people.name: Jordan Pike
people.bio: Celebrating a promotion with far too many friends in a standard room.

people.name: Helen Morrow
people.bio: Has an eight o'clock flight and has called the desk three times.

people.name: Teodor Halasz
people.bio: In town for a trade fair. Has had a long evening in the Lobby Bar and cannot find his room card.

people.name: Elin Nyholt
people.bio: On a late anniversary drink in the Lobby Bar when her husband collapses.

people.name: Ravi Sethna
people.bio: Night crew lead on the harbourfront ambulance. Wants a clear handover and a clear route.

people.name: Owen Tremlett
people.bio: Twenty-two years on the bell stand. Knows every regular and every shortcut, and does not love paperwork.

people.name: Hattie Coombe
people.bio: Runs the loading dock from 05:00. Practical, fast, and tired of the dock door alarm.

people.name: Mara Lindgren
people.bio: Left two bags with the bell stand before a late meeting. One of them is not there now.

people.name: Idris Kellaway
people.role: Station Officer, Port Avener Fire & Rescue
people.bio: Runs the night watch at the harbour station. Wants plans, keys and facts, in that order.

people.name: Gwendolyn Ashcombe
people.bio: In town for a conference. Came in out of the rain and went down on the marble.

people.name: Declan Fenner
people.bio: Fixes the kitchen's extract and gas lines overnight. Fast, good, and short on paperwork.

people.name: Keziah Morland
people.bio: Eight months in banqueting. Quick, well liked, and careful about what she says to managers.

people.name: Duncan Pellmore
people.bio: Twelve years in banqueting and runs a big room well. Thinks of himself as everyone's favourite uncle.

people.name: Sunniva Haig
people.bio: Works the same section as Keziah most weekends. Notices everything and says little.

people.name: Celia Wrenfield
people.bio: Runs the Harbour Ballroom's events and its bar stock. Organised, overloaded, protective of her team.

people.name: Kit Albury
people.bio: Sets up and breaks down the ballroom bars. Friendly with the regular bar staff from the agency.

people.name: Henrike Solberg
people.role: Regional LP Auditor, Veldane Hotels & Resorts
people.bio: Audits LP programmes across the region's hotels. Fair, exact, and impossible to rush.

people.name: Hamish Lorrimer
people.bio: Owns the hotel's budget and its forecast. Likes options with numbers, dislikes surprises.

people.name: Rosalie Dunmore
people.bio: Here for her sister's wedding with her son Theo, who is seven and fast.

people.name: Rhosyn Calder
people.role: LP Manager, Veldane Airport Port Avener
people.bio: Runs LP at the airport hotel with three officers and a lot of goodwill. Proud of her team, wary of the flagship telling her how.

people.name: Anneliese Thorburn
people.bio: Fights every chargeback line by line and keeps a spreadsheet of the ones she lost.

people.name: Rory Pennant
people.bio: Four years on evenings, Colm Brady's oldest friend on the team. Easy company, and lately easy on his patrols.

people.name: Harriet Oyelaran
people.role: Environmental Health Officer, Port Avener Health Department
people.bio: Investigates outbreaks across the city's kitchens. Wants samples, logs and the truth, early.

people.name: Garrick Tamsett
people.bio: Says he fell on the lobby steps last month and has a solicitor's letter to prove it.
